final_response.answer: Virginia Tech’s AI focus is centered in the CS department, with courses like CS 4804 Introduction to AI covering fundamentals, while the ML track leans on advanced CS electives and interdisciplinary offerings that emphasize statistical learning and data‑driven modeling. AI classes tend to have higher average grades (CS 4804 A/A‑ rate ≈ 80.6%) compared to some ML‑heavy courses, which often draw from more mathematically intensive material. Both paths share core programming and algorithm foundations, but AI leans toward reasoning and knowledge representation, whereas ML emphasizes model training and evaluation.
